title: The Designer Models
intro: Barb invites you to the workshop to inspect the first finished piece of her beachwear collection.
line: Barb: Well? I tried it on myself. That makes you the first person allowed to judge the fit.
close: You admire the stitching and ask whether she is nervous. Barb adjusts her hat, smiling despite her blush.

title: One More Minute
intro: Laca has finished her lifeguard shift and sits on the wooden station steps, watching the beach.
line: Laca: You actually brought me something cold? Careful. I might start expecting visits after every shift.
close: You hand her the drink. She lingers on the steps, chatting a little longer than either of you expected.

title: The Fitting Room Challenge
intro: After closing, Barb asks for a second opinion on her newest black-and-pink design.
line: Barb: Look me in the eyes when you answer. Does the new cut work, or are you distracted?
close: You offer a careful critique of the straps and detailing. Barb laughs, pleased that you noticed the work.

title: The Champion’s Weak Spot
intro: The practice room is nearly empty. Reina stays behind to review the match with you.
line: Reina: You won one round. Do not mistake that for getting inside my head.
close: She hides a smile behind a sharp comeback, then invites you to stay for another practice duel.

title: Caught in the Rain
intro: A sudden storm interrupts Camila on an open terrace. She waves you closer, laughing at the weather.
line: Camila: Are you going to stand there looking impressed, or help me rescue the cushions?
close: You both gather the scattered belongings before retreating into the warm cafe together.

title: Midnight Temptation
intro: At the quiet waterfront pool, Luna waits beneath violet reflections and a clear night sky.
line: Luna: So you came. I was beginning to think you were afraid of a little moonlight.
close: You sit beside the water and talk privately until the lights along the shore begin to dim.
